$comment: Overlay B (Android), adopted 2026-10-02. The first release goes straight to Google Play (owner decision B39 of 2026-10-14, S0010), so channels is ["play"] and, with it, the compliance gate SZA-SURF01 requires a hosted privacy page (the zero-data carve-out is not honest for a product with microphone and camera broadcast): S0033 declared both on 2026-10-25. The hosted pages are GENERATED into site/ by tools/site/build-site.ps1 from docs/PRIVACY_POLICY*.md and are never hand-edited; the product landing (S0014) joins site.pages when it exists. A sideload channel (github) is added to channels the day one opens (INSTALL-TRUST binds then). Shapes: flavor - two variants, store and noLegal, of one codebase; wear and watchface are sibling modules of the same build, not editions.
